summary: Phase 7 source, schemas, validators, and tests exist and pass on the host. No pilot may begin: every pilot entry gate that depends on a published, signed stable release is unmet, and Phase 7 inherits the stable-release blockers recorded in operations/data/stable-qualification.json.

entryGateNotes.stableReleasePublished: STABLE_RELEASE_GO_NO_GO.md records NO-GO. No stable version, tag, or candidate exists.
entryGateNotes.signedStableArtifacts: build/keys contains no release public key and no candidate artifact has been signed.
entryGateNotes.reproducibleBuildEvidence: make reproducible-build-check fails closed by design; a second independent builder comparison has never been run.
entryGateNotes.postReleaseSecurityReview: POST_RELEASE_SECURITY_REVIEW.md does not exist because no release occurred.
entryGateNotes.postReleasePrivacyReview: POST_RELEASE_PRIVACY_REVIEW.md does not exist because no release occurred.
entryGateNotes.phase7SecurityReview: PHASE_7_SECURITY_REVIEW.md exists and records source-level findings with no unresolved Blocker or Critical item in Phase 7 source.
entryGateNotes.phase7PrivacyReview: PHASE_7_PRIVACY_REVIEW.md exists and documents exactly what an organisation administrator can see.
entryGateNotes.multiTenancyIsolationTests: tests/multitenancy passes on the host, including adversarial cross-organisation cases.
entryGateNotes.syncCryptographyIndependentReview: No independent cryptographic review has been commissioned or completed, and no reviewed cryptographic backend is installed.
entryGateNotes.oemRecoveryValidation: No physical OEM hardware has been qualified and no recovery media has been booted.
entryGateNotes.supportCapacityConfirmed: Operational capacity is one maintainer with no funded support rota; see SUSTAINABILITY_REPORT.md.

pilotDefinition.scope: Internal engineering devices only, no external participants.
pilotDefinition.incidentProcess: docs/ENTERPRISE_AUDIT.md and the existing security disclosure process
pilotDefinition.rollbackPlan: Unenrol every device and select the previous bootc deployment.
pilotDefinition.exitPlan: Unenrol every device, revoke all certificates, rotate sync keys, and delete the organisation record.
